pages.text: $(bold)Space will kill you without protection.$()$(br2)The pack has three tiers of space-capable armor, and each one lets you survive on different planets. Pick by where you are going.

$(bold)Basic Space Suit$()$(br)Ad Astra's default suit, crafted from Netherite and Ad Astra materials. It holds oxygen and gives basic protection, enough for the $(bold)Moon$() and $(bold)Mars$().$(br2)$(bold)Netherite Space Suit$()$(br)The upgrade, made with materials from Mars. It protects better against heat and cold, and you need it to survive $(bold)Venus$() and $(bold)Mercury$().

$(bold)MekaSuit$()$(br)Mekanism's power armor fills the Jet Suit's role: flight, space survival and modular upgrades. Already locked behind T4 Mekanism progression, it is your main space armor.$(br2)$(bold)MekaSuit Mk2$()$(br)The $(italic)best$() armor in the pack: a MekaSuit plus Aethersteel, Glacio materials and Primordial Essence. No other space armor accepts Apotheosis affixes, custom enchantments and socket gems.

$(bold)Note: Jet Suit Removed$()$(br)Ad Astra's Jet Suit is not in the pack and has no recipe; the MekaSuit fits the progression better.$(br2)$(bold)Soulbound is Critical$()$(br)Death costs more out there: {{dim ad_astra:moon death}} of your gear's durability on the Moon, up to {{dim ad_astra:glacio death}} on Glacio. Soulbound III on your suit is close to mandatory.$(br2)$(bold)Next: the Moon.$() Its hazard is the lowest, and its Lunar Stride books make every later planet easier.
